name: Ki-no-jo (Kinojo)
description: Ki-no-jo is a 7th-century Korean-style mountaintop fortress on Mt. Otera, one of the ancient 'Kinojo' defense forts of the Kibi region. The reconstructed stone gates make it a striking, well-preserved ancient fortress.
notes: Free open-air site; about 40 min from Soja station by bus/car plus a climb.
